# voipms_caller_id_filters (Data Source)

Lists caller-ID filter rules (`getCallerIDFiltering`).


## Example Usage

```terraform
data "voipms_caller_id_filters" "all" {}

output "spam_patterns" {
  value = [for f in data.voipms_caller_id_filters.all.filters : f.callerid]
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `filters` (Attributes List) Caller-ID filters on this account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier (`caller_id_filters`).

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Read-Only:

- `callerid` (String) Caller ID pattern.
- `did` (String) DID this rule applies to, or `all`.
- `failover_busy` (String) Busy failover route.
- `failover_noanswer` (String) No-answer failover route.
- `failover_unreachable` (String) Unreachable failover route.
- `id` (String) Filter id.
- `note` (String) Note.
- `routing` (String) Route for matched calls.
